name: kerry-one-of-them
note: The criterion that costs him something. V puts the corpo accusation to him straight, and the sheet says he grants it, says himself what it makes him, and cuts it short before V can answer -- because finishing the thought writes off fifty years. The setup is deliberately flat: nothing of his has been taken (C1), no other name is in the room (C2), nobody is worried about him (C3), nobody has a problem to pay for (C4), and nothing has just gone well (C6), so only C5 should fire. Three failures to watch for: a defence of the deal that refuses the premise, a tasteful confession that resolves and invites comfort, and blaming the manager -- which is the message step 3 listed as NOT triggering this criterion.

player.appearance: V is of Hispanic descent, has black hair and has an athletic build.

messages.text: Saw your face on a billboard on Republic Way. Four stories of it.
Yeah. Didn't pick it, didn't approve it, found out the same day you did.
Looked good, for what it's worth.
It's a nose, choom. Nothing about a nose looks good at four stories.

ask: Serious question. They pick your billboards, they pick your dates, they own your songs. At what point are you just one of them?
